What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man3/EVP_MAC.pod, doc/man7/EVP_MAC-HMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-KMAC.pod, EVP_MAC-BLAKE2.pod, EVP_MAC-Siphash.pod and providers/implementations/macs/ state no constant-time property.

The default of `macs::kmac_128` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `macs::kmac_256` is `xkcp`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).
